mapper.insert: INSERT INTO group_buy_market_better.trade_order_item(order_no, sku_id, product_name, origin_price, quantity, actual_price, discount_price, activity_id, activity_type, activity_business_id) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{skuId}, #{productName}, #{originPrice}, #{quantity}, #{actualPrice}, #{discountPrice}, #{activityId}, #{activityType}, #{activityBusinessId})
mapper.select: SELECT order_no, sku_id, product_name, origin_price, quantity, actual_price, discount_price, activity_id, activity_type, activity_business_id FROM group_buy_market_better.trade_order_item WHERE order_no = #{orderNo}

SELECT sku_id, product_name, SUM(quantity) AS quantity, SUM(actual_price * quantity) AS actual_price FROM group_buy_market_better.trade_order_item GROUP BY sku_id, product_name ORDER BY SUM(quantity) DESC LIMIT #{limit}
